en: A vintage-style postcard showing a bustling seaport scene with large steamships docked at a pier, crowds of people on the quay, and cargo such as crates, barrels, and bundled goods stacked in the foreground. The image is bordered with a decorative torn-edge effect. At the bottom there is bilingual text in Bulgarian and English that identifies the view as Varna Port in 1906.
